::api-operation{method="POST" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/wallet/topup"}
#docs
A `paid` top-up on a payment method whose bank must get advance notice of each debit (e-mandates on some gateways) is not charged at once: we send the notice and answer 400 with `error.retry_after`. Send the same amount again after that time to charge it.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | Customer id (cus_…) |

## Headers

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Idempotency-Key` | `string` | no | Safely retry writes — repeats return the original response. If a write FAILED after it had already taken effect, that failure is what repeats: the key is spent, and a new attempt needs a new key. |

## Body

The request body is **required**.

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | **yes** | The amount to add, in minor units. |
| `currency` | `string` | **yes** | The wallet's currency (ISO-4217 code). |
| `type` | `string` | no | The kind of top-up. One of `paid`, `granted`. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `wallet_topup`. One of `wallet_topup`. |
| `id` | `string` | The top-up id. |
| `credit_type` | `string` | The credit type. One of `paid`, `granted`. |
| `amount_minor` | `integer` | The top-up amount in minor units. |
| `currency` | `string` | The currency code. |
| `balance_minor` | `integer` | The wallet balance after the top-up, in minor units. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `201` | Topped up |
| `400` | Top-up failed |
| `404` | No such customer |
| `409` | Idempotency-Key conflict — the key is already in flight, or was reused with a different request payload. |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl -X POST "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customers/cus_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/wallet/topup" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "amount_minor": 2900,
    "currency": "USD"
  }'
```
